title: Umonde owahlala ixesha elide kunentlungu
intro: Umdala owayenomonde owaba yintsomi, umbono wakhe waphela ngenxa yosizi, kodwa ukholo lwakhe kwisicwangciso sikaThixo aluzange lugungqiswe. Lo mntu wabukela oonyana abalishumi elinesibini bekhula baba ziziseko zezizwe, walahlekelwa kabuhlungu ngumntwana othandekayo, waza waba luphawu olungapheliyo lomonde omhle xa wayejongene nosizi olukhulu. Umphefumlo ohlonitshwayo onebali elichazwe kumaphepha esityhilelo. Ungamchaza lo mntu kwiQuran?
clues: Ndandingumprofeti obali lakhe lichazwe ngokweenkcukacha kwi-surah enkulu yeQuran.
Ndanoonyana abalishumi elinesibini ababa ngooyise bezizwe zakwaBani kwaSirayeli.
Ndibaxelele oonyana bam ukuba bangene ngamasango ahlukeneyo, hleze babonwe njengabantu abangatshatanga.
Amehlo am amhlophe ngenxa yokulila okungapheliyo ngenxa yomntwana endimthandayo othatyathwe kum.
Andizange ndivume ukuphelelwa lithemba nangona abanye oonyana bam bendicenga ukuba ndibe njalo, besithi ndikhalaza ku-Allah kuphela.
Ndinguyise womprofeti uYusuf, ogama lakhe lithetha 'umnyusi' ngesiArabhu.

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
